leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a generic type that filters object keys based on value type
Apply conditional types to evaluate type compatibility within mapped types
Implement the KeysMatching type using key remapping and type inference
Manipulate union types to extract matching keys from object structures
Integrate the KeysMatching type with existing TypeScript interfaces
Configure type constraints to ensure type safety during key extraction
Render type-safe functions that accept only specific property keys
